sentences.text:
1 This Court after going through the record finds that in the report of Public Analyst Uttar Pradesh,
Lucknow dated 13.11.2009, the opinion has been recorded as follows:-
"On the basis of the standard of mixed milk the sample is about 51% deficient in milk Fat and about 1% deficient in milk solids not fat.
The sample is substandard hence adulterated."
There does not appears to be any adulteration of the sample by any toxic substance which can be said to be harmful for human consumption.
Apart from above, this Court finds that the memo of recovery said to have been made from the appellant was not found to be proved by the trial court.
The trial court has discussed the ingredients of the offences alleged against the respondents but not found them to be proved and has acquitted the respondents.

After hearing the learned A.G.A., considering the documents on record and the judgment of the trial court, we find do not find any ground for allowing this application for leave to appeal noted above.

[Order on memo of Appeal] In view of the fact that the application for leave to appeal is dismissed,
consequently, the appeal is also dismissed.
.
(Brij Raj Singh, J.) (Siddharth, J. ) Order Date :- 8.8.2024
